direction: First-chapter hand-painted city; distinct architecture, matte asphalt, offset ruined street and integrated rubble

A.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Redraw this overly neat city into an abandoned URBAN RUIN while retaining its successful hand-painted palette, varied building identities, high overhead camera, visible short side walls and SOLID MATTE asphalt material. Opaque portrait 1024x1536, one finished scrolling game map.

The road is currently far too straight, symmetrical and empty, and the buildings look maintained. Change those decisively:
- Make the street a broad, gently offset/dogleg route: the clear asphalt path shifts left through one block and right through the next. Curbs and building setbacks are staggered and locally broken, not two parallel straight borders or a perfect smooth sine-wave river. Preserve continuous visible solid asphalt, ordinary intersections and recognizable urban street geometry.
- Collapse part of an upper building wing and one lower building corner. Show roof/floor breaks, exposed structural slabs and a few large concrete pieces. Rubble must spill FROM those broken faces across the sidewalk and noticeably onto the asphalt. Give it attached contact shadows. Use irregular clusters of large/medium/small chunks, not neat stone piles at every corner.
- Add ruined material ON THE ROAD: broken pavement slabs, scattered masonry, 2–3 sunken/potholed asphalt sections exposing muted brown-grey subgrade, a bent roadside barrier and one abandoned damaged car partly intruding into the lane. Include a few quiet scattered fragments away from the curb. A number of lane/crosswalk marks are chipped, interrupted or missing, not clean ruler-straight stripes.
- Let weeds and grass invade a broken pavement patch and one abandoned forecourt. Keep a mixture of intact and damaged buildings; do not turn every building into the same ruin shape. Damage should be clearly readable at phone size, not merely a few hairline cracks.

The middle stays usable as a low-contrast flight background but must not be a completely empty straight ribbon. Debris is decorative map art, not glowing gameplay obstacles. Maintain the distinct residential/commercial building shapes already present, avoiding cloned white flat-roof blocks or repeated paired air-conditioners.

Preserve the earlier road correction: charcoal/slate MATTE ASPHALT, subdued non-directional value patches and repairs. ABSOLUTELY NO water ripples, wave bands, long diagonal flow strokes, swirls, glossy wet reflections or river-like shading. Natural brush clusters remain in vegetation/rubble, buildings retain clear constructed edges. No dense grunge microtexture, general blur or yellow dirt wash.

High bird's-eye view with roofs dominant and narrow side-wall/window/door strips, warm upper-LEFT light, cool side faces and grounded lower-RIGHT shadows. Integrate buildings, courtyards, road and rubble in one physical ground with no floating platform skirts, bright outline bevels or pasted stickers.
Top/bottom 10% remain low open street connection ground, roughly centered and compatible in width/color, without a tall roof or wall cut by the edge. A few low road fragments are fine. No clouds, fog, people, aircraft, enemies, projectiles, UI, text, logos, transparency, watermark or extra panels.

C.prompt:

Production opaque portrait scrolling game-map texture, 1024x1536, ONE finished modern abandoned INDUSTRIAL/SERVICE city segment. Image 1 is first-chapter STYLE/CAMERA reference. Roof planes dominate, preserve narrow compressed side walls, door openings and window bands; no tall full-height building elevations, low isometric view, pure roof-only view or mixed projections. Modern industrial city architecture, no arches or gothic structures.

Solid continuous slightly irregular central ASPHALT street, middle roughly 40% calm/open for gameplay. Quiet matte charcoal-blue grey with broad low-contrast non-directional value variation, sparse concrete repairs, small worn tire marks and a few branching cracks. NEVER paint water ripples, waves, long diagonal flowing streaks, swirls or glossy reflections on the road. Sparse faded loading lines. Broad concrete forecourts, thin flush curbs and connected ground contacts, not dense tile grids, floating lots, bright platform rims or pasted isometric stickers.

Same first-chapter hand-painted anime background: larger simplified color planes, painterly vegetation and rubble clusters, clear constructed roof edges and readable loading doors. Warm light from upper LEFT; cool short side walls and moderate grounded lower-RIGHT contact shadows. Avoid huge dark wedge shadows, dirty all-over noise, fine photorealistic texture, tiny mechanical clutter, blur or toy miniature finish. Truck, crates and rubble painted with the same materials and shadows as their yard.

Top/bottom 10% low quiet open street connection matching image 2's endpoint position, width and muted asphalt color; no tall roof/wall or long shadow cut by an edge. No clouds, fog, actors, aircraft, enemies, weapons, projectiles, pickups, UI, text, logos, watermark, transparency or extra panels. ONE finished map.

Show exposed structural slabs and beams, broken large concrete pieces and masonry spilling from those exact faces over the sidewalk onto the road. Add irregular loose chunks and broken pavement slabs on the asphalt itself, 2–3 muted potholes/subsided areas exposing brown-grey subgrade, interrupted road paint and one abandoned damaged delivery TRUCK partially in the loading lane. A bent fence/guardrail and weeds from a cracked forecourt support the abandoned setting. Maintain a mixture of intact and damaged buildings.
Road debris must be readable at phone size; it is integrated painted scenery with grounded contact shadows, no glow and no gameplay pickup silhouettes. The flight background remains low contrast. Do not substitute just a few hairline cracks or neat decorative stone piles beside otherwise pristine buildings.
Keep SOLID MATTE ASPHALT without any water ripples, wave bands, long diagonal flow marks, swirls or wet reflections. Top/bottom street endpoints roughly match image 2's position, width and muted grey, with low connection ground and no tall sliced architecture. ONE finished map, no clouds, actors, aircraft, UI or extra panels.

promptFiles.prompt-a.txt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Production opaque portrait scrolling game-map texture, 1024x1536, ONE finished modern abandoned city scene. The supplied first-chapter image is a STYLE AND CAMERA reference only. Borrow its soft clustered vegetation, clear constructed facility edges, restrained detail and painted color planes. Do not copy its water, island, coastline, airfield or layout.

The previous city draft had two problems: asphalt looked like water due to diagonal wavy brush streaks, and every building repeated the same square roof and paired air conditioners. Correct both decisively by drawing a NEW urban arrangement with clearly varied architectural silhouettes.

Segment A: a residential neighborhood. Left middle is a modest pale-cream L-shaped apartment block enclosing a small planted courtyard, with narrow balconies and a few rooftop water tanks. Lower left is a pair of smaller contemporary townhouses with shallow muted blue-grey pitched roofs. Right side is a stepped low-rise residential building with two roof terraces and a short corner grocery frontage/awning at pavement level. Use different building footprint sizes and roof silhouettes. Buildings are not four cloned office boxes. Do not scatter identical twin-fan rooftop units across all roofs.

High bird's-eye orthographic painting: roofs dominate, a short compressed side-wall/window/entrance strip remains visible, similar to the first-chapter facilities. No tall multi-storey fronts, low isometric camera, pure roof-only satellite view or mixed perspectives. Modern ordinary architecture, rectangular windows, no arches, cathedral motifs or monumental buildings.

Continuous slightly irregular asphalt street through the middle, central roughly 40% quiet and unobstructed for gameplay. Thin ordinary curbs, connected sidewalks, small forecourts and tree groups. Keep the top and bottom 10% low open asphalt cross-street ground with no roof/wall cut by the edge. Endpoint road width, center position and color should work as a scrolling companion set.

ASPHALT MUST LOOK LIKE SOLID MATTE ASPHALT: flat muted charcoal-blue grey, subdued broad non-directional value patches, a few repaired patches, a small amount of worn tire marks and 2–3 sparse branching cracks. Road paint worn and restrained. NO water-like ripples, wave bands, long diagonal brush ribbons, swirls, glossy reflections or repeated wavy texture. Road is quiet painted pavement, not a sea texture. Sidewalks use broad clean concrete planes with sparse joints, not a dense floor-tile grid. Roofs are broad quiet painted planes too.

Hand-painted anime background: painterly brush clusters are most visible in grass, leaves, rubble and localized worn edges; buildings retain firm readable roof outlines, doors and window bands. Natural environment is softer than architecture. No photoreal microtexture, all-over grunge/noise, general blur, polished 3D miniature look or thick outline halos.

Soft warm sunlight from upper LEFT, cool blue-grey shaded short walls, restrained grounded shadows toward lower RIGHT. Buildings, sidewalk, courtyard and contact shadows are painted as one integrated ground region, no floating platforms, bright perimeter bevels, pasted stickers or huge dark wedge shadows. Pale warm concrete, muted slate asphalt, restrained olive/teal greens. Local abandoned-city damage on one corner and a few larger rubble shapes; otherwise material surfaces are clean and legible. A small parked abandoned car may be painted into a residential forecourt with contact shadow.

No clouds, fog, aircraft, actors, enemies, weapons, projectiles, pickups, UI, text, logos, watermark, transparency, extra panels or comparison layout. Output ONE full-frame finished map.
promptFiles.prompt-a-correction.txt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this city map only, same opaque portrait 1024x1536.
Keep the successful solid matte asphalt material with sparse repairs/cracks, hand-painted vegetation, warm upper-left light, cool side walls, residential building variety (L-shaped courtyard apartment, stepped terrace building, smaller blue pitched-roof homes), connected ground and localized ruin damage.
Two focused corrections:
1. WIDEN the main central quiet asphalt street to about 38–42% of the image width (roughly x=300 to x=720), by moving/compressing the residential lots toward the outer edges. Preserve a slight natural variation in curb alignment rather than perfectly mirrored rows. The street must remain a continuous physical road. Keep low open cross-street ground at the top and bottom.
2. Raise the painted viewpoint slightly: roofs should dominate more, while retaining short side-wall bands, small balcony/window details and doorway contacts. Foreshorten the visible tall apartment fronts by roughly one third. Do not turn into roof-only satellite imagery or make a lower isometric facade view.
Do not reintroduce diagonal flowing brush streaks, wave/ripple bands, glossy road reflection, repeated white office blocks, paired air conditioner clones, dense roof/pavement gridding, dirty noise, giant shadows, floating buildings, platform bevels, clouds, aircraft, text, UI or extra panels. Keep the established matte road and distinct residential architecture.
